items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And also another one they called Gus Permer. He was great.

ctx.x: I knew him, got to hear him. He was wonderful I thought too. Anything else about those early pianists that you can remember?

Well there were some great piano players down through and some of the greatest, one of the greatest piano players ever I looked at was Cooney Vons. He was from Hattiesburg, Mississippi. And they had another one there they called Blind Jug. He was a good. And also another one they called Gus Permer. He was great. Yeah.
Well, what about some of the bands, what type of music did they play when you heard them?
